verses.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.

xrefs.text: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

verses.text: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

xrefs.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

verses.text: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.

xrefs.text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
He gives rain to the earth and sends water upon the fields.
until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.
Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

verses.text: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.

xrefs.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!

verses.text: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

xrefs.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”

verses.text: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.

xrefs.text: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague was halted.
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.

Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
And that very night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians. When the people got up the next morning, there were all the dead bodies!

verses.text: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.

xrefs.text: On that night I will pass through the land of Egypt and strike down every firstborn male, both man and beast, and I will execute judgment against all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.

And every living thing on the face of the earth was destroyed — man and livestock, crawling creatures and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth, and only Noah and those with him in the ark remained.
Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
those men who had brought out the bad report about the land— were struck down by a plague before the LORD.
Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,

verses.text: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.

xrefs.text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great— even beyond the borders of Israel.’”
The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.text: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—

xrefs.text: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

verses.text: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

xrefs.text: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
You will know that your tent is secure, and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home.

verses.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

xrefs.text: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully,
The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.

xrefs.text: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.

and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

“If You are the Son of God, he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’

verses.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.

xrefs.text: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.”
they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.
David added, “The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.” “Go,” said Saul, “and may the LORD be with you.”
The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.text: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.

xrefs.text: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

verses.text: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

xrefs.text: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.

verses.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”

xrefs.text: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”

No longer will a nursing infant live but a few days, or an old man fail to live out his years. For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
